en.hubeali:
And by this chain, 
‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘
If there is anything with evil omen in it, so it is in the tongue’.
en.sarwar: 17. Through the same chain of narrators it is narrated from the Messenger of Allah (a.s.) has said, the following: “The Messenger of Allah (a.s.) has said, ‘
If there is any wickedness, it is in the tongue.’”
